name: MindGuard AI
description: Mental Health Awareness & Suicide Prevention Agent — an agentic AI platform providing empathetic mental health awareness, early distress detection, grounded AI conversation, risk-aware prevention support, and safe escalation to human crisis resources. This application is an educational and awareness support tool, not a medical service or replacement for professional mental health care.
problem_statement: Agentic AI for Mental Health Awareness & Suicide Prevention

ibm_granite.authentication: IBM Cloud IAM — API key exchanged for Bearer token
ibm_granite.note: Currently operates in simulation mode with local fallback. Production requires valid IBM Cloud credentials in environment variables.

workflows.name: mental-health-chat
workflows.description: Core mental health conversational workflow. Routes user messages through IBM Granite with mental health context and safety guardrails.

workflows.name: rag-query
workflows.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation workflow for evidence-based mental health information retrieval.

workflows.name: journal-analysis
workflows.description: Emotional pattern analysis workflow for user journal entries.

ibm_langflow.note: Currently operates in simulation mode. Production requires a deployed Langflow instance and valid flow credentials.

workflows.name: crisis-escalation
workflows.description: Automatically routes high-risk users to crisis intervention resources, shows emergency banners, and suggests helplines when serious distress signals are detected.

workflows.name: wellness-reminder
workflows.description: Sends scheduled wellness check-in reminders to encourage consistent self-care engagement.

workflows.name: weekly-wellness-report
workflows.description: Generates a personalized weekly wellness summary including mood trends, stress analysis, and top recommendations.

ibm_orchestrate.note: Currently operates in simulation mode. Production requires valid IBM Orchestrate credentials.

rag.note: Production implementation should use a real vector database (e.g., IBM Watson Discovery, Chroma, or Pinecone) with proper text embeddings. Current implementation uses simulated similarity scoring.

agentic_architecture.workflow: Monitor → Detect → Analyze → Risk-Assess → Prevent → Recommend → Escalate

agents.name: Awareness & Education Agent
agents.description: Provides evidence-based mental health awareness information, psychoeducation, mindfulness resources, coping strategies, and self-care guidance.
agents.safety_note: Does not present as a medical professional. Does not diagnose conditions.

agents.name: Conversation & Empathy Agent
agents.description: Maintains empathetic, non-judgmental supportive conversation using IBM Granite. Listens actively to user concerns and validates emotions using compassionate language.
agents.safety_note: Clearly communicates it is not a replacement for professional mental health care.

agents.name: Distress Detection & RAG Agent
agents.description: Retrieves relevant trusted mental health information using the RAG pipeline and identifies possible distress signals from user-provided conversation inputs using keyword and semantic analysis.
agents.safety_note: Does not claim to diagnose any mental health disorder. Identifies signals only.

agents.name: Risk Assessment Agent
agents.description: Evaluates safety-related signals based on defined keyword and pattern analysis. Classifies risk as Low, Medium, or High and triggers appropriate system responses. Uses conservative escalation for any detected high-risk indicators.
agents.safety_note: Does not make clinical diagnoses. Does not guarantee suicide prediction or prevention. Escalates conservatively when serious signals are detected.

agents.name: Prevention & Recommendation Agent
agents.description: Suggests appropriate low-risk coping strategies, self-care actions, and professional support options grounded in retrieved knowledge base content.
agents.safety_note: Encourages professional support. Does not prescribe treatments or medications.

agents.name: Human Support & Escalation Agent
agents.description: Provides international helpline and crisis resource information. Encourages immediate human assistance when high-risk signals are detected. Uses IBM Orchestrate crisis-escalation workflow in production.
crisis_resources: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (US) — Call or text 988
Crisis Text Line — Text HOME to 741741
International Association for Suicide Prevention — iasp.info
agents.safety_note: Never attempts to replace emergency services or professional mental health care.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinates all specialized agents. Routes user inputs to the appropriate capability. Maintains conversation context. Applies safety rules before generating final responses. Integrates IBM Langflow workflow routing.

environment_variables.VITE_IBM_API_KEY: IBM Cloud API key for IAM authentication
environment_variables.note: No secrets are stored in this file. All credentials must be configured in environment variables. Never commit .env files to version control.

safety.disclaimer: MindGuard AI is an educational awareness and support tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or a qualified mental health professional immediately.
safety_principles: Always provide crisis helplines when high-risk signals are detected
Never claim to prevent suicide or guarantee outcomes
Always recommend professional mental health care for clinical concerns
Use conservative escalation — when in doubt, escalate
Clearly communicate the tool's limitations in every session
Never leave a high-risk user without access to crisis resources

grounded_ai.description: AI responses are grounded in retrieved evidence-based mental health content from the application knowledge base, not generic model outputs. User context (emotion, risk level, conversation history, mood data) is injected into IBM Granite prompts to generate farm-and-context-specific responses.
context_sources: Sleep and exercise mental health research

metadata.deployment_note: Vite SPA. Run 'vite build' to generate static assets in dist/. Deploy dist/ to IBM Cloud Object Storage, IBM Code Engine, or any static host. No server-side runtime required for the frontend.
production_requirements: Configure VITE_IBM_PROJECT_ID and VITE_IBM_API_KEY for IBM Granite
Deploy a Langflow instance and configure VITE_LANGFLOW_* variables
Configure VITE_ORCHESTRATE_* for IBM Orchestrate crisis workflows
Replace simulation mode flags in service files with production API calls
